scope: Selected shared immutable blob-pack architecture; full synthetic day, compact/entropy. No record-level R2 archival or orphan deletion. Thirty-day hot and seven-day recovery are projection assumptions. Original IDs/relationships retained. Synthetic byte retirement only. Host CPU is not Worker CPU.
